concerns.text: T017 'Run baseline and full regressions specifically for the permutation-test stage' is listed as depending only on 'T001–T004 (independent regression for permutation stage)', but it consumes the aligned dataset and coupling-function predictors. It must depend on T016 (aligned_for_us2.parquet) and T008 (coupling functions); as written, T017 could execute before any data exists — a consumer-before-producer violation.

T013, T014, and T015 are tagged [P] (parallel-safe) yet the dependency table itself gives T013 dependencies on T005–T012/T018–T020, T014 'after T013', and T015 'T013 (full pipeline)'. These are strictly sequential orchestration/documentation/e2e tasks; the [P] tags are incorrect and would allow out-of-order execution.

T016 'runs its own alignment' to produce aligned_for_us2.parquet, duplicating T007's alignment output with a second, potentially divergent dataset feeding the same downstream analyses (T008/T009 consume T016 while T021/T007 produce aligned.parquet). Either T016 should consume T007's output or the duplication must be justified; two parallel producers of the 'aligned' artifact breaks the single-artifact flow in plan.md Phase 2→3 and data-model.md step 2–3.

Dependency table lists T009 → T008 only; T009 (regression) also directly consumes the aligned dataset from T016. Transitively covered via T008→T016, but the table should state it explicitly to avoid an implementer running T009 on a stale/absent dataset.

T012 (sensitivity/FDR) consumes permutation p-values, but T011 emits three separate files (permutation_o_fe/he_h/c_o.json) while plan.md Phase 9 and data-model.md specify a single permutation_results.json input to sensitivity.py. The producer/consumer artifact names do not match; align the file contract so T012's input is well-defined.
